d: Pappu Yadav On Nitish Kumar : purniya sansad pappu yadav ne bihar ki rajniti aur INDIA gathbandhan ko lekar kaee bare bayan die hain...pappu yadav ne bijepi, narendr modi aur amit shah par nishana sadhte hue saval uthaya ki aakhir tin mahine ke andar aisa kya huaa ki nitish kumar ko mukhyamantri pad chhorna para? unhonne aarop lagaya ki nitish kumar ko rajnitik rup se kamjor karne ki ranniti banaee gaee...pappu yadav ne INDIA gathbandhan ke gathan ka jikr karte hue rahul gandhi aur soniya gandhi ki bhumika par bhi apni bat rakhi... unhonne dava kiya ki kangres netritv chahta tha ki nitish…
